summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on persistent glitches related to Mall data for real-time analytics. It was determined that the fix should ideally be implemented on production, although initial testing could occur on staging.

Regarding a new factor addition after the model, two options were discussed:
1. **Model Update:** Creating and deploying an updated model incorporating the new factor.
2. **Factor Rollout:** Directly rolling out the new factor into the system.

The factor needs to be applied both in real-time and retroactively (backdating to February 6th).
decisions: The glitch fix for Mall data should be deployed on production.
The new factor must be applied retroactively to February 6th.
action_items: Determine the fastest method (model update vs. direct factor rollout) to incorporate the new factor into the system.
